note: One record per decision point. The rubric beside this file defines the classes; this file fixes the shape a tool may write and a later stage may read.

packet_id.constraint: 32 lowercase hex characters, and present in inputs/diagnostic/manifest.json

revision_subtypes.constraint: both directions, not one: event_class == structural_revision requires 1 to 3 unique values from the list, and event_class != structural_revision requires the empty array. A structural revision with no subtype is refused, because the rubric asks which kind it was.
revision_subtypes.order: not meaningful; values do not repeat

terminal_stage.constraint: both directions, not one: event_class == terminal_transition requires ready or confirmed, and event_class != terminal_transition requires null. A terminal transition without a stage is refused, because only ready is used for terminal localization and the two must never merge.

file.format: JSON Lines, one record per line, append only
file.first_line: a header object, not a record

header.chain_index_sha256: sha256 of the external chain index
header.viewer_commit: the repository HEAD the viewer ran at
header.independence_attestation: I had not viewed the graph, plan, summary, audit, or method outputs for these trajectories before primary annotation.

completion.note: The final hash cannot live inside the file it hashes. It is written beside it, with the label count and the completion time, once the last label is in and the file is closed. Any later edit makes the sidecar fail.

invariants: exactly one primary record per packet_id
a record is written when the annotator advances and is read-only afterwards
records appear in the order the chain was read
adjudication is a separate file and never rewrites a primary record
